thread:
harper-marketing: Quick ask for tomorrow's spotlight demo: can runtime run a tiny verification probe? Need results by 08:00 PT. Specs: 24 requests (8 short/8 medium/8 long), models: redwood-base-7b fp16 and base-7b-q4 fallback. Baseline without KV cache and one cached comparison. Deliverables: latencies.csv (include seq_len), p50/p90/p99, coldstart heatmap, sampled traces for p95+, and one logits snapshot for any long-case p99. Keep wall time under 20m.

dave-runtime: Can do. Qs: include node tag in CSV? traces sampled as you requested?

harper-marketing: Yes to node tag. Sample p95+ and first cold request per node.

sam-ops: Heads-up: maintenance window 03:00-04:00 PT on shared pool. Recommend running at 06:10 PT.

dave-runtime: Scheduling baseline 06:10 PT (run_id=sp-2991234601) and cached comparison 06:45 PT. Concurrency capped at 3. Outputs: latencies.csv, percentiles.png, heatmap.png, traces.tgz, logits_snapshot.tar.gz.

bench-bot: Job queued sp-2991234601 (est 12m).

bench-bot: sp-2991234601 completed. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/runs/sp-2991234601/spotlight_probe.zip

harper-marketing: Downloaded. Found a long-case p99 at req-007. Please attach trace and logits and quick note.

dave-runtime: Included traces/req-007.json and snapshots/logits-req-007.npy.gz. Short note: spike aligned with brief host interrupt on gpu-dedicated-14 during first-token decode; not model-related. Re-ran on gpu-dedicated-15, no spike.

sam-ops: We'll flag gpu-dedicated-14 for follow-up and recommend reserving gpu-dedicated-15 for rehearsal.

harper-marketing: Can you paste a 3-bullet summary for the rehearsal doc?

dave-runtime: Summary: "Spotlight probe (n=24 across short/medium/long) on redwood-base-7b (fp16) with q4 fallback. Artifacts: per-request latencies (seq_len & node), percentile plots, coldstart heatmap, sampled traces, and logits snapshot for long-case p99. Observed isolated p99 tied to host interrupt on gpu-dedicated-14; not reproduced on gpu-dedicated-15. Recommend using gpu-dedicated-15 for rehearsal."

harper-marketing: Great, thanks all :rocket: Closing thread.
